# Keeper Security

> Keeper Security is a zero-trust and zero-knowledge identity security and Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. Keeper provides a unified control plane for privileged access, secrets, remote connections, endpoints and databases – securing identities for humans, machines and AI agents from a single cloud-native platform.

Keeper's flagship product is KeeperPAM, which unifies enterprise password management, secrets management, connection management, privileged session management, endpoint privilege management and database access. The platform is FedRAMP High Certified, GovRAMP High Authorized, SOC 2 Type 2 attested, ISO 27001/27017/27018 certified and FIPS 140-3 Validated. Encryption and decryption happen locally on the user's device under a zero-knowledge model; Keeper cannot decrypt customer data.

## Products

- [KeeperPAM](https://www.keepersecurity.com/privileged-access-management/): Cloud-native, AI-enabled PAM platform unifying credential vaulting, secrets management, privileged session management, endpoint privilege management and database access.
- [Enterprise Password Management](https://www.keepersecurity.com/enterprise.html): Credential management for enterprise teams. SSO, SCIM, RBAC, audit logs, Verify Mode anti-phishing.
- [Business Password Management](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html): Password management for small and mid-sized teams.
- [Endpoint Privilege Manager](https://www.keepersecurity.com/endpoint-privilege-management/): Local admin rights and application execution control on Windows, macOS and Linux. JIT elevation, approval workflows, expiration controls.
- [Keeper Secrets Manager (KSM)](https://www.keepersecurity.com/secrets-manager.html): Manages API keys, certificates and secrets for CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure and AI agents.
- [Keeper Connection Manager (KCM)](https://www.keepersecurity.com/connection-manager.html): Agentless, VPN-less remote desktop gateway with credential injection, session recording, co-browsing and ephemeral accounts.
- [Remote Browser Isolation](https://www.keepersecurity.com/solutions/remote-browser-isolation/): Web sessions executed in an isolated cloud browser, keeping credentials and browsing activity off end-user devices.
- [KeeperDB](https://www.keepersecurity.com/privileged-access-management/): Vault-embedded zero-trust database access inside KeeperPAM.
- [Password Manager for MSPs](https://www.keepersecurity.com/msp-password-manager.html): Multi-tenant password management for managed service providers.
- [Privileged Access Manager for MSPs](https://www.keepersecurity.com/msp-privileged-access-manager/): PAM for MSPs covering all client environments from one console.
- [Personal Password Manager](https://www.keepersecurity.com/personal.html): Password manager for individuals.
- [Family Password Manager](https://www.keepersecurity.com/family-plan.html): Up to five private vaults under one plan.

## Pricing

- [KeeperPAM](https://www.keepersecurity.com/pricing/keeperpam/): Custom quote via Sales. PAM and EPM licenses mix in one organization.
- [Business and Enterprise (Password Management)](https://www.keepersecurity.com/pricing/business-and-enterprise.html): Per-user, per-month pricing for Business Starter, Business and Enterprise plans.
- [Business Add-Ons](https://www.keepersecurity.com/pricing/business-add-ons/): BreachWatch, Secure File Storage, ARAM, KeeperChat, Compliance Reporting.
- [Personal and Family](https://www.keepersecurity.com/pricing/personal-and-family.html): Annual pricing for consumer vaults.
- [Student](https://www.keepersecurity.com/student-discount-50off.html): 50% discount, verified via ID.me.
- [Military and Medical](https://www.keepersecurity.com/id-me-verification.html): 30% discount, verified via ID.me.
- [Public Sector (Government Cloud)](https://www.keepersecurity.com/government-cloud/): FedRAMP High and GovRAMP Authorized for federal, state and local government.

## Trust and Security

- [Security Architecture](https://www.keepersecurity.com/security.html): Zero-knowledge encryption, AES-256-GCM, ECC, PBKDF2, post-quantum Kyber.
- [Trust Center](https://trust.keeper.io/): Current certifications, attestations, audit reports (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018, FedRAMP High, FIPS 140-3, GovRAMP High).
- [Keeper DNA](https://www.keepersecurity.com/features/keeper-dna): Smartwatch-based identity confirmation.

## Add-Ons

- BreachWatch (Dark Web Monitoring): Continuous credential breach monitoring.
- Secure File Storage: Encrypted file storage in the vault.
- Advanced Reporting and Alerts (ARAM): SIEM-ready audit logs and event alerting.
- Compliance Reporting: Reports for SOX, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, NIST, GDPR.
- KeeperChat: End-to-end encrypted messaging app.

See [Business Add-Ons pricing](https://www.keepersecurity.com/pricing/business-add-ons/) for details.
